text.en:
SUBORDINATE COURTS ACT (CHAPTER 6)

NOTIFICATION OF INCREASE OF

APPROPRIATE PRESCRIBED LIMIT UNDER PROVISO OF SECTION 17(5) S 34/1989 S 40/1998 S 83/2006

REVISED EDITION 2013

LAWS OF BRUNEI Subordinate Courts CAP. 6, N 1 1 [Subsidiary]

SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION Notification of increase of appropriate prescribed limit under proviso of section 17(5) Commencement: 20th September 2006 The Chief Justice, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, has increased the appropriate prescribed limit defined in section 17(5) as follows —

(a) the appropriate prescribed limit shall be exceeding $30,000 but not exceeding $50,000 for any person who is a Magistrate and occupies the post of — Chief Registrar; Chief Magistrate; Deputy Chief Registrar; Senior Magistrate; or Senior Registrar;

(b) the appropriate prescribed limit shall be $30,000 for any person who is a Magistrate and occupies the post of — Magistrate; or Registrar.
